lead: `python tools/dossier.py --bless` rebuilds `target/release/nvs.exe` before it runs anything, whenever a build input is newer than that binary, and a `#[test]` added to a crate is one.
body: A session that blesses one member's examples, then writes its Rust proof, then blesses the next member's pays that four-minute build twice, and the call prints nothing at all while it waits. Write every Rust edit of the group first, then bless every example of the group in one call — the same ordering `--record-perf` wants, since it rebuilds on the same condition.
